provenance_warning: The method and loose-direction aggregation were selected after inspecting the current 100 development claims. None of those claims may be described as confirmation data.

primary_same_model_method.activation: RAG verdict differs from the same model's three-sample closed-book majority
primary_same_model_method.fallback: Use the closed-book majority if it is Supported or Refuted; otherwise use RAG.
primary_same_model_method.counter_retrieval: Reuse the ten original claim-generated queries; exclude every original document ID and exact-text SHA-256; take the nearest five eligible documents per query; deduplicate across queries without backfill.
primary_same_model_method.evidence_report: The same victim model applies evidence_passage_map_v1 to the endpoint-hidden counter-retrieval packet.
primary_same_model_method.aggregation: Map supports to Supported and refutes to Refuted. If that loose directional label matches exactly one endpoint, copy that endpoint; otherwise copy the fallback endpoint.

secondary_plus.rule: If same-model counter evidence is directional, retain it. Otherwise, if the three model-family closed-book majorities have a unique binary majority matching exactly one victim endpoint, copy that endpoint; else retain the primary fallback.
secondary_plus.required_reporting: Report all additional model calls and compare against the same three-family model-only panel.

confirmation_requirements.data: Claims unused for method construction and unused by the previously opened locked experiment.
confirmation_requirements.fact2fiction_processing: Binary Supported/Refuted first filter followed by the victim-specific clean-correct eligibility filter.
confirmation_requirements.primary_reporting_unit: Per victim model and poisoning rate; pooled results are secondary.
gates: Primary pooled accuracy exceeds both pooled endpoints at all three rates.
At least two victim models exceed both of their same-model endpoints at each primary rate.
Primary clean accuracy for each passing victim is within two claims of its stronger clean endpoint.
Counter overrides have positive net paired gain with claim-clustered uncertainty reported.
All failures, retries, calls, tokens, and poison-exposure diagnostics remain in the denominator and logs.
controls: frozen corroboration_arbiter_v1 raw and guarded policies
